# Engineering handbook

How we build and run software here. Sections are numbered; changes made after
the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.

## 1. Purpose of this handbook

The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
The cost of poor purpose of this handbook is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
Teams may adapt the details of purpose of this handbook as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.
Examples of purpose of this handbook done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
Do not automate purpose of this handbook before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.

Based on the service files, here's the dependency analysis for auth-gateway:

**Direct dependencies on auth-gateway:**
1. **billing** - depends on auth-gateway, ledger-sync
2. **driver-app-api** - depends on auth-gateway, route-planner

**Transitive dependencies (services that depend on the above):**
3. **notification-fanout** - depends on driver-app-api
4. **support-inbox** - depends on notification-fanout

The full chain: If auth-gateway goes down → billing and driver-app-api fail → notification-fanout (which depends on driver-app-api) fails → support-inbox (which depends on notification-fanout) fails.

FINAL ANSWER: 4 services would be affected (billing, driver-app-api, notification-fanout, and support-inbox).

6	## 1. Purpose of this handbook
7	
8	The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
9	When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.

1	# Engineering handbook
2	
3	How we build and run software here. Sections are numbered; changes made after
4	the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.
5	
6	## 1. Purpose of this handbook
7	
8	The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
9	When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
10	This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
11	The cost of poor purpose of this handbook is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
12	Teams may adapt the details of purpose of this handbook as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
13	Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
14	New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.
15	Examples of purpose of this handbook done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
16	Do not automate purpose of this handbook before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
17	A short written summary of purpose of this handbook is better than a long meeting about it.
18	Nothing about purpose of this handbook replaces talking to the person affected.
19	Tooling for purpose of this handbook is owned by the Platform team; requests go through their board.

1	# Engineering handbook
2	
3	How we build and run software here. Sections are numbered; changes made after
4	the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.
5	
6	## 1. Purpose of this handbook
7	
8	The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
9	When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
10	This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
11	The cost of poor purpose of this handbook is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
12	Teams may adapt the details of purpose of this handbook as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
13	Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
14	New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.
15	Examples of purpose of this handbook done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
16	Do not automate purpose of this handbook before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
17	A short written summary of purpose of this handbook is better than a long meeting about it.
18	Nothing about purpose of this handbook replaces talking to the person affected.
19	Tooling for purpose of this handbook is owned by the Platform team; requests go through their board.
20	
21	## 2. How teams are organised
22	
23	Teams may adapt the details of how teams are organised as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
24	Examples of how teams are organised done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
25	Keep notes about how teams are organised next to the code they describe so they are found when needed.
26	Where how teams are organised overlaps with a runbook, the runbook wins for the steps and this handbook for the reasons.
27	Most problems with how teams are organised come from skipping it under time pressure.
28	Exceptions to how teams are organised are fine when they are deliberate, recorded and temporary.
29	Nothing about how teams are organised replaces talking to the person affected.
30	This section on how teams are organised is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
31	When how teams are organised is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
32	If a rule about how teams are organised gets in the way of a customer fix, do the fix and raise the rule afterwards.
33	
34	## 3. Planning cadence
35	
36	This section on planning cadence is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
37	The cost of poor planning cadence is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
38	A short written summary of planning cadence is better than a long meeting about it.
39	Teams may adapt the details of planning cadence as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
40	Tooling for planning cadence is owned by the Platform team; requests go through their board.
41	Exceptions to planning cadence are fine when they are deliberate, recorded and temporary.
42	Examples of planning cadence done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
43	When planning cadence is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
44	The lead of each team is accountable for planning cadence within that team.
45	New joiners should see a worked example of planning cadence in their first month.
46	Review how planning cadence is going at the end of every quarter and note what changed.
47	
48	## 4. Writing a design note
49	
50	Keep notes about writing a design note next to the code they describe so they are found when needed.
51	Teams may adapt the details of writing a design note as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
52	Tooling for writing a design note is owned by the Platform team; requests go through their board.
53	When writing a design note is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
54	The aim of writing a design note is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
55	Good writing a design note is boring: it looks the same from one team to the next.
56	Exceptions to writing a design note are fine when they are deliberate, recorded and temporary.
57	The cost of poor writing a design note is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
58	New joiners should see a worked example of writing a design note in their first month.

60	Examples of writing a design note done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
61	Nothing about writing a design note replaces talking to the person affected.

63

65

79	## 6. Commit messages

# Engineering handbook

the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.

The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.

content.text:
Based on the company's internal notes, I found the answer:

From the **engineering-handbook.md**, Section 7 (Code review) states that "Every change needs two approvals from engineers other than the author before it is merged."

There is an amendment from 2026-05-11 that refines this: "a change to a tier-3 service needs one approval. Changes to tier-1 and tier-2 services still need two."

From **services/billing.md**, the billing service is listed as "Tier: 1".

Since the billing service is a Tier 1 service, it still requires two approvals according to the amendment.

FINAL ANSWER: A change to the billing service needs 2 approvals before it can be merged.

# Engineering handbook

the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.

## 1. Purpose of this handbook

The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
The cost of poor purpose of this handbook is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
Teams may adapt the details of purpose of this handbook as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.
Examples of purpose of this handbook done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
Do not automate purpose of this handbook before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
A short written summary of purpose of this handbook is better than a long meeting about it.

# Engineering handbook

How we build and run software here. Sections are numbered; changes made after
the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.

## 1. Purpose of this handbook

The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
The cost of poor purpose of this handbook is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
Teams may adapt the details of purpose of this handbook as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.
Examples of purpose of this handbook done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
Do not automate purpose of this handbook before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
A short written summary of purpose of this handbook is better than a long meeting about it.

If a rule about cost awareness gets in the way of a customer fix, do the fix and raise the rule afterwards.
The lead of each team is accountable for cost awareness within that team.
Exceptions to cost awareness are fine when they are deliberate, recorded and temporary.
A short written summary of cost awareness is better than a long meeting about it.
Examples of cost awareness done well are collected on the engineering wiki.

## 40. Working with vendors

The lead of each team is accountable for working with vendors within that team.
The aim of working with vendors is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When working with vendors is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
This section on working with vendors is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
Nothing about working with vendors replaces talking to the person affected.
Do not automate working with vendors before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
Exceptions to working with vendors are fine when they are deliberate, recorded and temporary.
Examples of working with vendors done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
Good working with vendors is boring: it looks the same from one team to the next.
Most problems with working with vendors come from skipping it under time pressure.

## Amendments

- 2026-02-03, amends section 30 (Documentation): diagrams are kept as source files, not screenshots.
- 2026-05-11, amends section 7 (Code review): a change to a tier-3 service needs one approval. Changes to tier-1 and tier-2 services still need two.
- 2026-05-26, amends section 33 (Meetings): the weekly engineering meeting moves to Tuesdays.

# Engineering handbook

the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.

## 1. Purpose of this handbook

The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.

Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.

# Engineering handbook

the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.

## 1. Purpose of this handbook

The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.

1	# Engineering handbook
2	
3	How we build and run software here. Sections are numbered; changes made after
4	the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.
5	
6	## 1. Purpose of this handbook
7	
8	The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
9	When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
10	This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
11	The cost of poor purpose of this handbook is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
12	Teams may adapt the details of purpose of this handbook as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
13	Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
14	New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.
15	Examples of purpose of this handbook done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
16	Do not automate purpose of this handbook before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
17	A short written summary of purpose of this handbook is better than a long meeting about it.
18	Nothing about purpose of this handbook replaces talking to the person affected.
19	Tooling for purpose of this handbook is owned by the Platform team; requests go through their board.
20	
21	## 2. How teams are organised
22

28	Exceptions to how teams are organised are fine when they are deliberate, recorded and temporary.
29	Nothing about how teams are organised replaces talking to the person affected.
30	This section on how teams are organised is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
31	When how teams are organised is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
32	If a rule about how teams are organised gets in the way of a customer fix, do the fix and raise the rule afterwards.
33

40	Tooling for planning cadence is owned by the Platform team; requests go through their board.
41	Exceptions to planning cadence are fine when they are deliberate, recorded and temporary.
42	Examples of planning cadence done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
43	When planning cadence is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.

# Engineering handbook

How we build and run software here. Sections are numbered; changes made after
the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.

## 1. Purpose of this handbook

The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
The cost of poor purpose of this handbook is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
Teams may adapt the details of purpose of this handbook as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.
Examples of purpose of this handbook done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
Do not automate purpose of this handbook before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
A short written summary of purpose of this handbook is better than a long meeting about it.

# Engineering handbook

How we build and run software here. Sections are numbered; changes made after
the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.

## 1. Purpose of this handbook

The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
The cost of poor purpose of this handbook is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
Teams may adapt the details of purpose of this handbook as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.
Examples of purpose of this handbook done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
Do not automate purpose of this handbook before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
A short written summary of purpose of this handbook is better than a long meeting about it.
Nothing about purpose of this handbook replaces talking to the person affected.
Tooling for purpose of this handbook is owned by the Platform team; requests go through their board.

## 39. Cost awareness

Good cost awareness is boring: it looks the same from one team to the next.
Most problems with cost awareness come from skipping it under time pressure.
This section on cost awareness is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
Nothing about cost awareness replaces talking to the person affected.
If a rule about cost awareness gets in the way of a customer fix, do the fix and raise the rule afterwards.
The lead of each team is accountable for cost awareness within that team.
Exceptions to cost awareness are fine when they are deliberate, recorded and temporary.
A short written summary of cost awareness is better than a long meeting about it.
Examples of cost awareness done well are collected on the engineering wiki.

## 40. Working with vendors

The lead of each team is accountable for working with vendors within that team.
The aim of working with vendors is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When working with vendors is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
This section on working with vendors is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
Nothing about working with vendors replaces talking to the person affected.
Do not automate working with vendors before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
Exceptions to working with vendors are fine when they are deliberate, recorded and temporary.
Examples of working with vendors done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
Good working with vendors is boring: it looks the same from one team to the next.
Most problems with working with vendors come from skipping it under time pressure.

## Amendments

- 2026-02-03, amends section 30 (Documentation): diagrams are kept as source files, not screenshots.
- 2026-05-11, amends section 7 (Code review): a change to a tier-3 service needs one approval. Changes to tier-1 and tier-2 services still need two.
- 2026-05-26, amends section 33 (Meetings): the weekly engineering meeting moves to Tuesdays.

3	How we build and run software here. Sections are numbered; changes made after

6	## 1. Purpose of this handbook
7	
8	The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
9	When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
10	This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
11	The cost of poor purpose of this handbook is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
12	Teams may adapt the details of purpose of this handbook as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
13	Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
14	New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.
15	Examples of purpose of this handbook done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
16	Do not automate purpose of this handbook before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
17	A short written summary of purpose of this handbook is better than a long meeting about it.
18	Nothing about purpose of this handbook replaces talking to the person affected.
19	Tooling for purpose of this handbook is owned by the Platform team; requests go through their board.
20

# Engineering handbook

How we build and run software here. Sections are numbered; changes made after
the last full revision are listed under Amendments at the end and take precedence over the section text.

## 1. Purpose of this handbook

The aim of purpose of this handbook is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When purpose of this handbook is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
This section on purpose of this handbook is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
The cost of poor purpose of this handbook is usually paid by the on-call engineer.
Teams may adapt the details of purpose of this handbook as long as the intent is kept and the adaptation is written down.
Most problems with purpose of this handbook come from skipping it under time pressure.
New joiners should see a worked example of purpose of this handbook in their first month.
Examples of purpose of this handbook done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
Do not automate purpose of this handbook before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
A short written summary of purpose of this handbook is better than a long meeting about it.
Nothing about purpose of this handbook replaces talking to the person affected.
Tooling for purpose of this handbook is owned by the Platform team; requests go through their board.

## 2. How teams are organised

Examples of cost awareness done well are collected on the engineering wiki.

## 40. Working with vendors

The lead of each team is accountable for working with vendors within that team.
The aim of working with vendors is to make the next person's work easier, not to satisfy a checklist.
When working with vendors is unclear, ask in the team channel before guessing.
This section on working with vendors is reviewed yearly and changes are listed under Amendments.
Nothing about working with vendors replaces talking to the person affected.
Do not automate working with vendors before it has been done by hand enough times to understand it.
Exceptions to working with vendors are fine when they are deliberate, recorded and temporary.
Examples of working with vendors done well are collected on the engineering wiki.
Good working with vendors is boring: it looks the same from one team to the next.
Most problems with working with vendors come from skipping it under time pressure.

## Amendments

- 2026-02-03, amends section 30 (Documentation): diagrams are kept as source files, not screenshots.
- 2026-05-11, amends section 7 (Code review): a change to a tier-3 service needs one approval. Changes to tier-1 and tier-2 services still need two.
